_note: I050: note corrections found while writing docs/code/sprites-oam-animation.md. (1) DmaDynamicSpriteTiles named bosses and large monsters as candidates for the dynamic-tile bit (OQ-I005-6); CopA9_SetDynamicTileSource is the only code that sets $1A bit $8000 and its only call is InitPlayerActor, so only the hero is a dynamic-tile sprite; the scheduler block note says so too. (2) The w2_effect_player_overlay block note called $7E3800 a dynamic tile source; meta rows $30 and $47 of MetaStElles carry $7E3800 in the animation-table column (+8), the scene spritemap, and no script of the file uses COP A9. (3) Three part notes and two comments wrote 'default attribute $0372' as if $0372 were a constant; $0372 is the address of scene_sprite_attr, a variable whose high byte ApplySceneProfile writes (profile byte 4, bits 4-5) and whose low byte is never written, so the ORed value is the scene's sprite priority.
